heroHeadline: CDC count reaches 4,588 measles cases, roughly double all of 2025
heroSubtitle: CDC counts 4,588 confirmed 2026 cases (+178 in a week) with 479 hospitalizations and 43 outbreaks across 47 jurisdictions; 96% are outbreak-associated. Pennsylvania has at least 1,200 cases and six deaths. PAHO's US elimination status decision remains due November 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
